How the money works. Fans pay you on your own payment provider — this server only stores the link and counts how many times it was opened. That means there's no payout queue to wait on, no platform balance, and no cut taken. It also means the terms of whatever provider you link are between you and them, and any tax owed on what you receive is yours to handle. Worth a word with an accountant once the amounts get real.
